attributes.comments: Tuscaloosa-Birmingham EF-4 Tornado Path - April 27, 2011.  65 fatalities and about 1500 injuries were caused by this tornado.

attributes.damage_txt: Free-Standing Light Poles, Luminary Poles, Flag Poles (FSP)
attributes.comments: Hundreds of trees snapped and uprooted, with large luminary light poles on I-65 bent over due to the force of the wind.  Damage path looks to be almost 1.5 miles wide from end to end.
Damage viewed up to the Ashley Furniture Homestore off Exit 267.  Damage width ends near this location.
Damage width starts at the area where the future I-22 will junction interstate 65. Further evaluation suggests RFD surge through this location.

attributes.comments: House on metal frame surrounding houses EF2 west and EF1 east. Metal frame blown into tree NNE.

attributes.dod_txt: Destruction of engineered and/or well constructed residence; slab swept clean
attributes.comments: Anchor lots all present. Studs straight nailed from underneath. 2 per stud. Studs 12in on center except 8in around bends. Wood good quality. Studs 4in wide. Some sill plates gone.
This manhole cover popped out of its cradle and flipped 30' into the stream bottom to the north.
Fast food store.  Vieweed from across the street.
House catapaulted off brick supporting columns. House crashed into a tree to the north across the street.
Some walls collapsed.  The large tree protected the house from a catapulted house to the south.

limits: Static source-reported estimated areas and survey accounts. The overall EF4 rating is not uniform local damage. Source records at the same coordinates remain separate. Outside accounts are retained. Coordinate conversion does not establish field accuracy. No visible funnel, wind field, impact clock, failure sequence or calibrated damage prediction. Source-linked photographs are uninspected and unhosted.
